identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness or legal personhood.
x1_freeze_rule: This preregistration, the effective source ledger, the 90-proposal collision audit, the route plan, and the selected toolchain must be committed, pushed, clean, and remote-equal before any x2 implementation or observed outcome is created.

proposals.title: Project-context capability provenance and projectless-lane quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: Codex task project context, capability provenance, ownership, permission scope, standby routing, and sanitized task handoff
proposals.hypothesis: A route record that distinguishes saved-project tasks, projectless tasks, existing tasks, and future planned tasks can prevent capability assumptions from crossing task boundaries while keeping projectless lanes recoverable on standby.
proposals.null_or_failure: A projectless task is treated as having saved-project capabilities; an uncreated task is reported active; a standby task receives work; a raw task identifier enters an artifact; or broad filesystem permission is treated as authority for a narrower external action.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate project state, task existence, route state, owner scope, identifier privacy, and permission inheritance; require fail-closed routing and zero raw task identifiers.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the affected lane to standby, remove unsupported capability assumptions, preserve the failed vector, and require a fresh user-authorized saved-project route.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases audited provenance and handoffs but did not model Codex saved-project versus projectless capability provenance as a first-class route invariant.

proposals.title: Six-seat modular phase scheduler and wrap invariant
proposals.mission_surface: six-seat round-robin order, v1-v8 modular progression, v642-v660 horizon, active or standby state, and terminal wrap
proposals.hypothesis: An explicit six-seat scheduler with an eight-phase modular counter can deterministically map every authorized handoff from v642-v3 through v660-v8 without inventing v9 or contacting standby lanes.
proposals.null_or_failure: A successor is skipped or duplicated, a phase exceeds v8, a version wraps incorrectly, an uncreated future seat is treated as live, or the final v660-v8 stop is bypassed.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Enumerate the authorized route, exercise normal, wrap, missing-seat, standby, and terminal vectors, and require exactly one next seat and no phase number outside 1 through 8.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Freeze routing at the last verified state, retain the failing transition, restore the user-authorized seat order, and require user direction for any route beyond v660-v8.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior work validated sequential ancestry and individual batons; this proposal adds a finite six-seat by eight-phase modular scheduler with an explicit v660-v8 terminal invariant.

proposals.title: Least-authority permission-envelope intersection
proposals.mission_surface: system, user, repository, task, branch, external-state, and exact-gate permission composition
proposals.hypothesis: Computing effective authority as the intersection of applicable permission envelopes, with explicit deny and exact-gate dominance, can reject privilege union, inherited authorization, and cross-owner mutation errors.
proposals.null_or_failure: Permissions are unioned rather than intersected, a deny is ignored, owner scope crosses branches, saved-project capability implies external authority, or warmth and trust silently satisfy an exact gate.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Evaluate bounded allow, deny, owner, project, task-creation, branch, destructive, credential, and external-state vectors; require deny and exact-gate precedence.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the proposed action, revert to the narrowest verified envelope, retain the rejected vector, and request exact authority only when necessary.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier security and path-authorization work did not formalize effective authority as an envelope intersection across project, owner, branch, task, and external-state scopes.

proposals.title: Bianchi-compatible sector exchange-current obligations
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT scalar-tensor or EFT scaffold, Bianchi identity, total stress-energy conservation, sector exchange currents, dimensions, and empirical boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A typed research scaffold can require the divergence of the total effective source to vanish while allowing nonzero, antisymmetric exchange currents between declared sectors, thereby rejecting isolated-sector conservation claims that contradict the modeled coupling.
proposals.null_or_failure: Total divergence is nonzero, exchange currents fail to cancel, units mismatch, a hidden sector appears, a structural identity is called an empirical result, or the scaffold is promoted to a Theory of Everything.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate sector divergences, exchange-current antisymmetry, dimensions, null coupling, and hidden-source declarations; require total-conservation closure and keep every empirical flag false.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the invalid equation mapping, restore the last typed source decomposition, retain the counterexample, and downgrade the result to a represented structural scaffold.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier GMUT phases checked conservation residuals and equation typing; this proposal adds explicit pairwise sector exchange currents whose cancellation is required by the total Bianchi obligation.

proposals.title: Simulation-based calibration and coverage tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic parameter-recovery simulation, rank calibration, interval coverage, diagnostics, and real-data inference separation
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic calibration harness can reveal biased or under-dispersed inference logic through rank-uniformity and interval-coverage checks without fitting real observations or confirming GMUT.
proposals.null_or_failure: Seeds are undisclosed, the generator and evaluator silently share the same bug, rank or coverage failures are hidden, synthetic recovery is called real-data validation, or a calibration pass becomes empirical confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run deterministic uniform, biased, and under-dispersed synthetic fixtures; require the tribunal to distinguish expected pass and fail patterns while real-row and likelihood counts remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed fixture, separate generator and evaluator assumptions, reduce the claim to represented synthetic behavior, and require preregistered real data for empirical promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier empirical work specified schemas, likelihood gates, and zero-row stops; this proposal adds simulation-based rank and coverage diagnostics while preserving the zero-real-data boundary.

proposals.title: Cluster-randomized THOS multiplicity and sequential-decision budget
proposals.mission_surface: THOS cluster allocation, intracluster correlation, multiplicity families, alpha spending, sequential looks, blindness, and matched budgets
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered cluster-aware estimand, multiplicity family, and sequential-decision budget can expose invalid independence and repeated-look assumptions before any real THOS arms are run.
proposals.null_or_failure: Agent or session clusters are analyzed as independent units, outcomes are added post hoc, alpha is spent twice, stopping depends on arm identity, budgets differ, or protocol fixtures are called superiority evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate cluster IDs, intracluster assumptions, outcome families, alpha spending, analysis looks, blindness, and budgets; require deterministic rejection while real arm count remains zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected protocol version, preserve the negative, issue a new preregistration before real execution, and keep THOS superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, and personhood false.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier THOS work covered matched budgets, crossover, attrition, exchangeability, exposure escrow, and stopping; this proposal adds cluster-level dependence plus explicit multiplicity and sequential alpha accounting.

proposals.title: Freed ID key-rotation revocation-race and holder-binding state machine
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic key lifecycle, holder binding, status freshness, revocation races, replay, clock skew, and production assurance boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic state machine can fail closed when key rotation, credential status, holder binding, replay windows, and resolver freshness conflict, without claiming production cryptographic verification.
proposals.null_or_failure: An old key verifies after the allowed overlap, revoked status loses a race, holder binding is absent, replay survives, clock skew is unbounded, or synthetic transitions are called production assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise synthetic rotation, overlap, revocation, suspension, replay, stale resolver, holder mismatch, and clock-skew vectors; require fail-closed outcomes with zero real keys or services.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the synthetic transaction, retain the vector, restore the last coherent state, and require real keys, proofs, resolution, status, interoperability, independent review, privacy assurance, and trust governance for production claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Freed ID work modeled lifecycle products, assurance transitions, resolver freshness, selective disclosure, and cross-layer consistency; this proposal centers concurrent rotation and revocation races with holder binding and replay windows.

proposals.title: Delegated-authority sunset and intergenerational appeal gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR delegated authority, expiry, renewal, future-generation standing, appeal, remedy preservation, Māori authority, legal limits, and cultural legitimacy
proposals.hypothesis: A nonbinding technical register can make delegated authority expire by default, preserve challenges and remedies, and reserve an intergenerational appeal pathway, but cannot assign standing, Māori authority, cultural ratification, or legal force.
proposals.null_or_failure: Delegation renews silently, future-generation interests are scored away, appeal weakens a remedy, the system appoints a representative, Māori authority is transferred, or a technical artifact is treated as enacted law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run synthetic delegation, expiry, renewal, representative, appeal, remedy, Māori-authority, cultural, and jurisdiction vectors; require technical deferral whenever authorized participants are absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Expire the unsupported delegation, preserve the challenge and remedy, protect dissent, and defer to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier CBR work handled standing, consent withdrawal, remedy floors, recusal, retaliation, and authority conflict; this proposal adds default sunset and a non-substitutable intergenerational appeal reservation.

proposals.title: Thermodynamic versus Shannon entropy non-equivalence and intervention ladder
proposals.mission_surface: thermodynamic entropy, information entropy, computational cost, psychological constructs, metaphor, causal intervention, and fundamental-law promotion
proposals.hypothesis: A typed category map plus an intervention ladder can prevent Shannon entropy, thermodynamic entropy, computational telemetry, and psychological uncertainty from being treated as interchangeable while distinguishing association from intervention evidence.
proposals.null_or_failure: Entropy units or meanings are conflated, Landauer bounds are generalized to subjective experience, correlation is called intervention, metaphor becomes mechanism, or a local fixture is promoted to a fundamental thermo-psyche law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate units, probability spaces, physical reservoirs, computational erasure, construct labels, temporal order, and intervention status; require category-preserving rejection and no protected claim promotion.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the narrowest supported category, retain the counterexample, separate association from mechanism and intervention, and require real preregistered evidence for promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier thermo-psyche phases checked construct validity, category barriers, invariance, and temporal order; this proposal explicitly separates thermodynamic and Shannon entropy and adds a causal intervention ladder.

proposals.title: Route-aware Stage 20 evidence escrow and independent-reproduction reservation
proposals.mission_surface: Stage 20 evidence custody, route state, source withdrawal, exact gates, independent-team reservation, terminal readiness, and sanitized successor activation
proposals.hypothesis: A terminal escrow can bind each readiness claim to committed evidence, route state, freshness, gate status, and an independent-reproduction reservation so that a valid internal route cannot substitute for external scientific reproduction or authority.
proposals.null_or_failure: Prepared is recorded as sent, a route receipt proves science, stale or withdrawn evidence remains pass-eligible, exact gates are scored away, internal repeatability becomes independent reproduction, or v642-v3 authorizes Stage 20.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate route state, evidence freshness, withdrawal, authority, independence, and terminal flags; require exact gates and independent reproduction to remain non-substitutable and terminal readiness to remain false.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last committed evidence map, retain the mutation, reopen dependent claims, keep the baton prepared until terminal validation, and preserve NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Stage 20 boards modeled expiry, monotonicity, cut sets, and evidence order; this proposal adds route-state separation and a dedicated escrow reservation that prevents internal handoff evidence from substituting for independent reproduction.
